title: Momoi Airi — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Cafe

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hey, look everyone! Airi and the others are here!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
It's Airi! Hey everyone!
Glad you made it☆

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry to have kept you all waiting. Our livestream went great!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We all watched it together! Your solo was really incredible!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ If it was karaoke, everyone would've wanted to join in!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Aren't you glad they enjoyed it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, I know you're excited and all, but aren't you forgetting something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right!
Let's go, Emu!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here it is☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now that's a big box. What's inside?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehehe, time for the big reveal!
Ta-daa☆

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, a cake! It's so pretty and pink!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, it sure is—
Aaaah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh no, Saki! The decorations are missing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
Now it's just a plain old pink cake!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I guess so, now that you mention it...
Although, I thought that's what you were going for.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Oh no! This was supposed to be Airi's special birthday cake!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: This is terrible! Now we can't celebrate anymore!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hm? They look oddly happy about this...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't worry. Here's some fruit we can use to decorate it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Shii! Trust you to come up with a wonderful idea like that!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Just wait a moment, Airi! We'll have your cake decorated in no time!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, so this was the surprise, huh.
I expect some top-notch decorating from you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright!
Kohane, how about we line up the strawberries and kiwi slices?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'll work on the pineapple and mandarin pieces!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And we'll decorate with the blueberries and mango chunks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Wow, they're making good speed with this. I wouldn't be surprised if they even practiced.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh?
There's a gaping hole right in the center.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe. Why, that's to make room for these☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-daa♪ They're marzipan figurines of you, Airi! Emu and I made them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This is Happy Everyday Airi, then there's Airi in school uniform, and finally, MMJ Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wow, would you look at that! Did you guys seriously make these yourselves?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! We remembered the stuff you taught us and did our best to make them!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We tried our hardest!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe, I can tell they really tried their best to strike a balance with the head and body proportions, and the detail in the face and hair.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you, Saki, Emu.
You did an amazing job.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The Happy Everyday and idol me look so energetic, and the school me looks so smart. I love them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think they turned out really well!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hurray Saki! Airi complimented our handiwork!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yay! We did it, Emu♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Airi, we have something to show you, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, it's actually a surprise from Mizuki and Ena. Here you go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
An, Kohane, thank you.
This looks like a card...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? There's only a URL.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe, that URL is for a video. I'll play it for you!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wh-What! This is gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh! It's an animated short of us dancing and singing on stage!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, the poses and expressions are so in sync with the music.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Plus, I bet it was hard to illustrate every single pose.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Although Akito was the one who handed me the card, I also got a message from Ena for you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She said, “I was super hung up on the details so it's kind of short, but isn't it just the cutest?”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, it really is! I'm honestly lost for words!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That said, trust Ena to make her brother run errands for her...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of, he told me to tell you “have a good one”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe, thanks.
I'll make sure to thank Akito the next time I see him.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, now it's time to take a photo. Everyone gather in front of the cake♪
Ready, Kohane?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah! Now to set the timer, and...
Okay everyone, we've got ten seconds!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I got to celebrate with my fans, and now my friends are doing all this for me.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today really is the best!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Momoi. I hope you and Ena continue to be good friends. Of course, don't feel like you need to go out of your way for her though.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what's that all about? You make it sound like I'm a burden to her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
The only person you're burdening here is your li'l bro.
Thanks for delivering the card♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Since we spent all night editing, our faces looked terrible, so we couldn't possibly present it to her in person...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: All I did was give the card to Kohane and the others and pass on a message. Thank them instead.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We will. But thank you too, anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Airi, I'll tell you all about how we made the animated short next time we meet up! Again, happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi. I'm so glad you liked the cake and video surprises!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We managed to get quite a bit of cake decoration practice in by using small figurines and plastic fruit! I'm glad it all paid off.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh yeah, the marzipan figurines turned out well. I was a bit concerned when I heard we were going to leave those in the hands of Saki and Otori...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh, some of Airi's skill rubbed off on us! I mean, she taught us how to make faces, so all that was left was to keep trying until they were 100% perfect!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's what Happy Everyday said on TV♪
So we both gave it our all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah♪ Airi, we'll be your fans forever and ever and eeever! We're right behind you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi! Seeing you smile all day made me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was glad to see all our livestream fans and everyone at the party having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody loves you, Airi. They must have been happy to be able to celebrate so much today. I sure was!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's right.
Happy birthday, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I was really touched by everyone's birthday wishes and words of support.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It made me realize that every message I got was coming from somebody I gave hope.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I promise to keep spreading hope as Airi Momoi of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You right there!
Watch out 'cause I'm coming your way!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm just messing around.
